item.title: Local vendors thrive at Edgewater Indoor Market
item.description: The Edgewater Chamber of Commerce brought hundreds of people back to the Broadway Armory to buy fresh produce, baked goods and a variety of handmade products from around Chicago.

item.title: 2,500 runners brave cold for F3 Winter Half Marathon
item.description: Hundreds of brave souls didn't let the bitter cold or lingering lake effect snow dampen their spirits Saturday morning.

item.title: Judge orders release of 5-year-old Minnesota boy, father detained by ICE
item.description: U.S. District Judge Fred Biery admonished the administration’s removal of Liam Conejo Ramos and his father, Adrian Conejo Arias, saying the pair “seek nothing but the modicum of due process and the rule of law.”

item.title: PAWS Chicago Pet of the Week: Cascabel
item.description: CHICAGO — Saturday’s PAWS Pets of the Week is Cascabel, an energetic and loving two-year-old pup. Cascabel loves belly rubs and spending time chewing on bones. Think Cascabel could be the perfect fit for you? Head to PAWS Chicago’s Lincoln Park Adoption Center to find out how you can bring her home today.

item.title: 'Home Alone' and 'Schitt's Creek' actress Catherine O'Hara dies at 71
item.description: Catherine O'Hara, the Emmy-winning actor known for her comedic roles in "Home Alone" and "Schitt's Creek", died at 71 in Los Angeles after a brief illness.

item.title: Mayor Johnson signs executive order directing CPD to document and investigate misconduct by federal agents
item.description: CHICAGO — Mayor Brandon Johnson has signed an executive order directing Chicago police to document and investigate alleged illegal activity by federal immigration agents. On Saturday, Johnson signed EO 2026-01, also known as the "ICE On Notice" executive order, which also directs local law enforcement to refer evidence of felony violations by federal agents to the Cook County State’s Attorney's Office for prosecution.
